description: Extractive summary of any text, computed offline (no LLM): ranks sentences by term significance and returns the top ones in reading order. Set how many sentences you want. Key-less, instant, $0.002. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

sentences.description: How many sentences to return (1-20, default 3)

text.description: The text to summarize (up to 100k characters)

name: agentbit.text_summarize
title: Text Summarize (Extractive)
